releaseNotes: Shopping is tidier and easier to scan, with a compact overview, consistent ingredient rows and clearer quantities and prices.
The shopping list is better proportioned on wide tablets, without oversized cards and controls.
The Home update message now simply says Update available, with technical version details kept out of the notification.
Selected Favourites, Account and Settings buttons use colour only, without an underline.
Android downloads show clearer starting and automatic retry messages, including when the connection briefly pauses.
